pages.text: $(bold)Synergy overview$(reset): count the $(reset)non-native organs$(reset) by creature source; when one genome fills enough slots, a hidden "ecosystem set" bonus activates — the benefit of a pure build.$(br2)$(bold)Rules:$(reset)$(li)Native organs never count$(li)Group each source, keep the $(reset)largest group$(reset)$(li)$(reset)3+ organs$(reset) = minor synergy; $(reset)6+ organs$(reset) = major synergy (majority of the nine slots)$(br2)To trigger a set, that genome must form the majority — mixed builds trigger nothing.

pages.text: $(bold)$(reset)Warm-blooded set$(reset) (regeneration)$(li)Minor: Regeneration I (constant)$(li)Major: Regeneration II (constant)$(br2)$(bold)$(reset)Undead set$(reset) (night fighter)$(li)Minor: +10% melee damage at night$(li)Major: +15% melee damage at night$(br2)$(bold)$(reset)Aberrant set$(reset) (frenzy)$(li)Minor: 25% chance on hit taken for Speed I (2s)$(li)Major: 30% chance on hit taken for Speed II (3s)

pages.title: Ender and the other three sets
pages.text: $(bold)$(reset)Ender set$(reset) (escape artist)$(li)Minor: 15% chance to blink away when hit$(li)Major: 25% chance to blink away when hit$(br2)$(bold)$(reset)Explosive set$(reset) (blast-proof)$(li)Minor: -10% explosion damage taken$(li)Major: -20% explosion damage taken$(br2)$(bold)$(reset)Boss set$(reset) (boss slayer)$(li)Minor: +8% damage against boss-tier targets$(li)Major: +12% damage against boss-tier targets$(br2)$(bold)$(reset)Dragon set$(reset) (aerial ward)$(li)Minor: -50% fall damage taken$(li)Major: -75% fall damage taken$(br2)Note: Aberrant and Ender resolve $(reset)when you take a hit$(reset) — higher armor (smaller hits) means more frequent triggers; Warm-blooded and Undead are always-on / night passives, Explosive and Dragon are on-hit damage reductions, and Boss boosts damage against boss-tier foes — none depend on proc chance.

Synergy counts transplanted non-native organs; sources and transplant rules are in Seven Genomes and Installation & Care. For a temporary boost across a full build, check the Three Breakthrough Modes under Genotypes · Potions.
